text:
Calloway Mutual has financed the Garrow Heights housing scheme with a £48.6 million loan facility, announced on 14 March 2023.

The facility will fund 212 homes. That works out to roughly £229,000 of lending per unit.

Delphine Ashworth-Reyes, Head of Residential Lending at Calloway Mutual, confirmed the arrangement.

The report rests on the Garrow Heights Development Financing Agreement, filed with the Harrowmere Borough Planning Registry. The filing identifies Calloway Mutual as the lender behind the scheme.

**What it means for the sector**

A single-lender facility of this size signals that Calloway Mutual is committed to large residential development finance. For developers, a fully funded scheme of 212 homes reduces the need to assemble multiple funders. Rival lenders will be watching whether Calloway Mutual repeats the approach on other sites.
